purpose: Replicate the Solar long-horizon signal with fixed candidate architecture and current strong baselines on fresh validation seeds.
research_question: Does the prediction-connected variable-axis Mamba representation remain non-inferior to the strongest current Solar baselines at H336/H720 under identical data, budget, and seed contracts?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory replication. No test metrics are generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: The relation loss is retained as the requested AutoCon training component, but prior paired null screens did not establish an independent accuracy gain. This screen may establish only candidate-versus-baseline validation evidence, never a causal AutoCon accuracy claim.
prelaunch_gates: verify SolarEnergy source hash and numeric-array contract
freeze the candidate architecture and all training hyperparameters before fresh seeds run
use DLinear, iTransformer, and PatchTST for every dataset-horizon-seed baseline coordinate

phases.name: solar_strong_baselines_h336_h720_fresh
phases.purpose: Fresh paired current-source DLinear, iTransformer, and PatchTST Solar references.

phases.name: solar_nlinear_variable_mamba_autocon_h336_h720_fresh
phases.purpose: Frozen prediction-connected variable-axis Mamba with train-only ACF relation loss and AutoCon representation fusion.

comparison_contract.primary_contrast: NLinearVariableMambaAutoCon versus the best of DLinear, iTransformer, and PatchTST at the same dataset-horizon-seed coordinate
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: This is a fresh-seed validation screen. It cannot establish test accuracy, statistical significance, universal baseline superiority, or an independent relation-loss gain.
